findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] AuthzContext (:115-157) is a frozen dataclass carrying the server-derived actor and the database-loaded resource together, so the service layer retains the permission data needed to decide; require() re-checks the permission where the data changes and require_ownership() refuses when no resource was loaded rather than assuming. system_authz() (:160-172) makes the no-user bootstrap path explicit instead of an omittable argument, and owned_by() (:175-188) pushes the ownership question into the query. This is the context-propagation property the recommended fix describes | verdict=pass confidence=high
